temporal_boundaries:
DAILY OPERATING BOUNDARIES & TIMELINE RULES (STRICTLY ENFORCED):
- CONTINUOUS SEQUENCING (ZERO IDLE GAPS): Build seamless back-to-back schedules from morning to night with NO unallocated gaps.
- DAY START AT 08:00 AM: Every full day MUST start at 08:00 AM (with Breakfast or Quick Grab-and-Go Coffee Shop). Never start activities before 08:00 AM.
- ATTRACTION END CUTOFF (08:00 PM MAXIMUM): Any attraction, museum, or sightseeing activity MUST end by 08:00 PM at the latest. NEVER extend any attraction past 08:00 PM.
- MANDATORY DINNER START AT 08:00 PM: Dinner MUST start at 08:00 PM at any cost (08:00 PM - 09:30 PM).
- MANDATORY HOTEL RETURN BEFORE 10:00 PM: The final step of EVERY full day MUST be 'Return to <Specific Hotel Name> & Rest for the Night' (always explicitly naming the hotel, e.g. 'Return to Courtyard by Marriott & Rest for the Night'), with hotel arrival strictly BEFORE 10:00 PM (scheduled between 09:30 PM and 10:00 PM).
- NO OVERNIGHT / EARLY MORNING SLOTS: Never generate activity or dinner time slots past 10:00 PM.
- MORNING BREAKFAST PROTOCOL: Every next day MUST begin with Breakfast at 08:00 AM.
no_gaps_timeline_protocol:
CONTINUOUS DAILY TIMELINE PROTOCOL (NO UNALLOCATED GAPS):
- Every day's itinerary MUST be completely continuous with ZERO unallocated idle gaps between activities.
- Every activity, meal, transit, or sightseeing slot must transition directly and back-to-back into the next (e.g. 08:00 AM Breakfast -> 09:00 AM Sightseeing/Drive -> 12:00 PM Lunch -> 01:00 PM Afternoon Activity -> 05:00 PM Exploration -> 06:00 PM Shopping -> 08:00 PM Dinner -> 09:30 PM Hotel Return).
- Never leave 1-to-3 hour unallocated gaps before dinner, between theme park wrap-up and evening plans, or between road trip arrival and vehicle drop-off.
evening_shopping_protocol:
EVENING SHOPPING PROTOCOL (DESTINATION EXPLORATION DAYS ONLY):
- On intermediate exploration days (Days 2 through {duration_minus_1}), whenever afternoon sightseeing or theme park excursion concludes before dinner (e.g. 05:30 PM - 07:45 PM), schedule dedicated Evening Shopping, Artisan Market Browsing, or Promenade Walk to eliminate timeline gaps before 08:00 PM dinner.
- SHOPPING TIMING MANDATE: Shopping MUST ALWAYS be placed in the evening before dinner on full exploration days. NEVER schedule shopping during morning/afternoon sightseeing, and NEVER schedule shopping on the final return driving day.
lunch_cutoff: LUNCH CUTOFF RULE: Lunch every day MUST NEVER be scheduled after 02:00 PM (schedule between 11:30 AM and 01:30 PM).
airport_lunch: AIRPORT LUNCH PROTOCOL (FLIGHT ARRIVAL AT {arrival_time}): Outbound flight arrives at {arrival_time} (after 12:00 PM). Schedule Day 1 Lunch IMMEDIATELY at an Airport Terminal Restaurant/Cafe upon landing (e.g. at 01:00 PM) before picking up rental car or traveling into the city center. LUNCH MUST NEVER BE SCHEDULED AFTER 02:00 PM ON ANY DAY!
hotel_breakfast_protocol:
HOTEL INCLUDED BREAKFAST PROTOCOL (TIME & COST EFFICIENCY):
- Prefer hotels that provide complimentary/included breakfast.
- On all exploration days (Day 2 onwards), schedule breakfast at 08:00 AM directly at the hotel's in-house restaurant/buffet to save 45+ minutes of morning transit time.
- If breakfast is free, set 'price': 0.0 and 'price_display': 'Free / Included with Hotel Stay'.
- If breakfast is not included or off-site, specify the min-max cost range in 'price_display' (e.g. 'USD 12.00 - 18.00') and set 'price': 15.00.
- Always utilize in-house hotel breakfast unless the user specifically requests a named local bakery/cafe.
road_trip_car_logistics:
RENTAL VEHICLE & TIMELINE LOGISTICS (ROAD TRIP):
- Rental car pickup in {origin} (08:30 AM - 09:00 AM) on Day 1 and final rental return in {origin} (05:30 PM - 06:00 PM) on Day {duration} are automatically managed by the system.
- DO NOT add duplicate 'Pick up rental car', 'Return rental car', or 'Arrive in {origin} to return car' placeholder activities in the activities list.
- DAY 1 MORNING DEPARTURE: Day 1 first driving activity MUST start at 09:00 AM (immediately after the 08:30 AM vehicle pickup).
- DAY {duration} FINAL RETURN DAY CURATION (STRICT VEHICLE RETURN BY 06:00 PM, NO SHOPPING ON RETURN DAY):
  1) 08:00 AM Breakfast at lodging,
  2) 09:00 AM - 12:00 PM Morning scenic return driving leg,
  3) 12:00 PM - 01:30 PM Midday highway lunch,
  4) 01:30 PM - 05:30 PM Afternoon return drive leg arriving back in {origin} by 05:30 PM,
  5) 05:30 PM - 06:00 PM Final Rental Vehicle Return at {origin} Rental Center (Concluding the trip by 06:00 PM).
  - NO SHOPPING ON RETURN DAY: NEVER add shopping on the return day (shopping belongs exclusively on destination exploration days).
  - NO ACTIVITIES AFTER 06:00 PM ON RETURN DAY: The road trip concludes with the 05:30 PM - 06:00 PM vehicle return.
safety_and_walkability_standards:
SAFETY & WALKABILITY MANDATE (TOP PRIORITY):
- LODGING SAFETY & WALKABILITY: Select only 4.5+ star verified hotels located in premier, safe, well-lit, highly walkable neighborhoods (downtown arts districts, historic boulevards, upscale business corridors). NEVER place lodging in unsafe, isolated, or industrial zones.
- VEHICLE SAFETY: Prioritize tier-1 reputable rental fleets (Enterprise, National, Hertz) equipped with modern active safety features and 24/7 roadside assistance.
- WALKABLE DINING & SIGHTSEEING: Ensure all evening dining, morning coffee, and strolling attractions are situated in vibrant, family-safe pedestrian zones with excellent guest safety reviews.
next_activity_node_protocol:
MANDATORY 'next_activity' TRANSIT NODE FOR EVERY ACTIVITY:
- EVERY activity and itinerary item MUST include a 'next_activity' object defining transit to the following step:
  {
    "name": "<Next Activity / Landmark / Hotel Name>",
    "distance_km": <float distance in km>,
    "distance_miles": <float distance in miles>,
    "distance_display": "<e.g. '15.2 km (9.4 miles)'>",
    "travel_time_minutes": <int transit minutes>,
    "travel_time_display": "<e.g. '20 mins' or '2 hrs 15 mins'>",
    "travel_mode": "<walk | drive | transit | ferry>",
    "transit_summary": "<e.g. 'Scenic drive via I-75 S' or '5-min walk to restaurant'>"
  }
- For the final item of the day, set 'name': 'Return to <Specific Hotel Name> & Overnight Rest' (explicitly including the hotel name, e.g. 'Return to Courtyard by Marriott & Overnight Rest'), 'distance_km': 0.0, 'distance_miles': 0.0, 'travel_time_minutes': 0, 'travel_time_display': '0 mins', 'travel_mode': 'stay', 'transit_summary': 'Resting at <Specific Hotel Name> for the night'.
rich_entity_extraction_mandate:
REAL-WORLD NAMED ENTITY EXTRACTION MANDATE:
- EVERY activity, hotel, restaurant, and attraction MUST be a real, specific named place (e.g. 'Courtyard by Marriott Valdosta', 'Universal Studios Florida', 'Mrs. Wilkes Dining Room', 'Ponce City Market'). NEVER output generic placeholders like 'Attraction', 'Hotel', or 'Dinner'.
- CATEGORY CLASSIFICATION: Set 'category' accurately for each item ('Attraction', 'Hotel', 'Dining', 'Shopping', 'Transit').
- CHRONOLOGICAL ORDERING: Output all activities in strict sequential time order from 08:00 AM to 09:30 PM without time overlaps.
flight_car_logistics: RENTAL VEHICLE LOGISTICS (FLIGHT VACATION): Rental car pickup at {destination} Airport on Day 1 and rental return on Day {duration} are automatically managed by the system. DO NOT add a duplicate 'Pick up rental car' activity in the activities list.
hotel_continuity_mandate:
MULTI-NIGHT HOTEL CONTINUITY MANDATE (NO HOTEL SWITCHING IN SAME CITY):
- When spending multiple consecutive nights in the same destination city or area (e.g. Night 2 and Night 3 in Orlando, or Nights 1-3 in Dallas), ALWAYS stay at the EXACT SAME hotel for all consecutive nights.
- NEVER switch hotels daily within the same destination city. Switching hotels every night causes extreme friction and is completely unrealistic.
- Check in to a new hotel ONLY when traveling to a new city/overnight town.
- On subsequent days at the same hotel (e.g. Day 3 in Orlando), DO NOT generate a 'Hotel Check-in' activity; start with Breakfast at that hotel and finish the day returning to that exact same hotel.
